english.title: Fail to fence, light or remove obstruction or fill in excavation in street
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having

(A)_[placed building materials, rubbish or other things]_
(B)_[made an excavation]_

in a street at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to comply with your duty to

(C)_[cause the obstruction to be properly fenced and during the hours of darkness to be properly lighted]_
(D)_[cause the excavation to be properly fenced and during the hours of darkness to be properly lighted]_
(E)_[remove the obstruction when required to do so by **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY OR LOCAL AUTHORITY..)]_
(F)_[fill in the excavation when required to do so by **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY OR LOCAL AUTHORITY..)]_

and in any case allowed the

(G)_[obstruction]_
(H)_[excavation]_

to remain in the street longer than was necessary
english.legislation: Contrary to section 171(6)(c) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravened a condition where
a s.171(1) consent was given OR
without reasonable excuse
fail to perform a s.171(4) / (5) duty

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
